reason: Evidence in the repository shows this plugin is primarily an approval-automation extension for DeepSeek Harness: it adds an Auto mode permission preset and intercepts user confirmation-required tool calls so they are handled through rule checks, optional LLM review, and prompt-based fallback. Its core behavior is changing how tool invocation permissions are decided in-session rather than adding domain tools. Because it can auto-approve and only then optionally ask for confirmation, its impact is operational risk in tool execution flow, and it depends on outbound model calls and configured policies.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供“Auto mode”权限模式，可按规则与模型审核自动处理需确认的工具调用，并在必要时引导用户确认。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an Auto mode to DeepSeek Harness that automatically handles permission-gated tool calls using configured rules, review logic, and optional confirmation prompts.

capabilities: Automates approval decisions for permission-gated tool calls in DeepSeek Harness.
Supports configurable allow/deny rule matching and pre-approved tool allowlist handling.
Invokes an LLM review model with conversation context for non-routable tool requests.
Provides an ask path that can surface manual confirmation choices.
Handles failure behavior via failClosed or fallback approval-chain settings.
Requires outbound network access for review model calls.

reasons.code: Auto mode is inserted as a permission preset and used by the DSH permission picker to drive tool-call decisions.
Decision flow includes explicit deny/allow rule priority, pre-approved tools, and model-based allow/reject/ask outcomes.
Uncertain or unsupported model outcomes can reject automatically (failClosed) or fall back to the normal approval chain.
Plugin manifest declares network:outbound and ui:extend permissions in workshop metadata, indicating runtime UI extension plus external model usage.
